summary: Added an inline error excerpt to ToolCallCard's error state and an explanatory CSS note about the failed card carrying its own error text. Then cleaned up the conversation empty-state: deleted the unused ConversationPlaceholder component, removed its dead CSS, and made the surviving thread-empty block workspace-aware using workspaceNameFromPath. Deduplicated the `/reload` extension reload action in Composer.svelte so the slash command executes a shared reloadExtensions function, and expanded the compact-context tooltip text.
decisions: ToolCallCard derives inline error text by walking the `errors` array entries (handling string | {message} | {error}) with a fallback to truncated result content, rather than rendering a separate Diagnostics component.

Delete ConversationPlaceholder.svelte outright and remove its CSS, because MessageList's branch never actually triggers the component (store.messagesLoading is intercepted and the empty condition is handled by Conversation).

Workspace-aware empty thread uses workspaceNameFromPath from ../../extensions/workspace-label; copy reads "Ask about {workspaceLabel} to start." when a workspace is selected, otherwise "Ask about your workspace to start.".

Dedupe /reload by routing the composer's local 'reload' command through the same shared reloadExtensions() function used by the `/reload` literal — keeps both entry points working but collapses the magic string sniffing.
Expand compact-context tooltip to "Compact context now — older history is summarized to free space" to make the destructive nature visible.
